mapper.select: select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.plant_cd, e.use_yn from mst_equip e where e.equip_cd = #{equipCd}

select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where m.mwo_type = 'BM') as bm, count(*) filter (where m.mwo_type = 'CM') as cm, count(*) filter (where m.mwo_type = 'PM') as pm, count(*) filter (where m.status in ('REQ', 'OPEN', 'WIP')) as open, coalesce(sum(floor(extract(epoch from (m.down_end_at - m.down_start_at)) / 60)) filter (where m.down_start_at is not null and m.down_end_at is not null), 0)::bigint as down_min from cms_mwo m where m.equip_id = #{equipId} and m.status <> 'CANCELLED' and m.reported_at >= #{from} and m.reported_at < #{to}

select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where r.status = 'DONE' and r.result = 'OK') as ok, count(*) filter (where r.status = 'DONE' and r.result = 'NG') as ng, count(*) filter (where r.status = 'SKIPPED') as skipped, count(*) filter (where r.status = 'OPEN') as open, count(*) filter (where r.status = 'OPEN' and r.due_date < #{today}) as overdue from cms_chk_run r where r.equip_id = #{equipId} and r.due_date >= #{fromDate} and r.due_date <= #{toDate}

select count(*) as lines, count(distinct p.item_id) as items from cms_mwo_part p join cms_mwo m on m.mwo_id = p.mwo_id where m.equip_id = #{equipId} and m.status <> 'CANCELLED' and coalesce(m.finished_at, p.created_at) >= #{from} and coalesce(m.finished_at, p.created_at) < #{to}

select
where c.use_yn = 'Y' and (c.equip_id = #{equipId} or c.asset_id in (select i.asset_id from mst_asset_install i where i.equip_id = #{equipId} and i.removed_at is null and i.void_yn = 'N')) order by c.target_type desc, c.counter_cd

select h.* order by
h.kind h.ref_no h.at
desc nulls last,
h.kind, h.src_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
